newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pique says privatisation won't be rushed.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pique says privatisation won't be rushed.

text.p: Spain's Industry Minister Josep Pique said the government would not rush the privatisation process and that sales would be conducted when market conditions were favourable, local media reported on Tuesday.
The privatisation process will not take place "hastily, but throughout the legislative period," Pique said according to press reports.
"Sales will be done in accordance with market conditions and following existing business plans," he added.
The government's objective is to improve management at public groups and reduce public support.
He also added that Spain needs to create large groups capable of competing globally, the press reported.
